description: Action->key mapping for Phosphor. Chords are human-readable strings (e.g. Ctrl+Z). Inspired from PabloDraw, Moebius, and Icy Draw.

actions.title: Export ANSI…
actions.description: Export the active canvas as an ANSI/text file.

actions.title: Close Canvas
actions.description: Close the current canvas/document (prompts to save if there are unsaved changes).

actions.title: Clear Selection / Cancel
actions.description: Clear selection or cancel current selection operation.

actions.title: Delete Selection (Destructive)
actions.description: Delete selection. If selection spans full row width or full column height, shift-delete; otherwise clear in place.

actions.title: Shift-Delete Selection (Row/Column)
actions.description: Shift-delete a full-row or full-column selection (keeps canvas size).

actions.title: Delete Row (Shift Up)
actions.description: Delete the caret row by shifting rows up (keeps canvas size).

actions.title: Delete Column (Shift Left)
actions.description: Delete the caret column by shifting columns left (keeps canvas size).

actions.title: Insert Row (Shift Down)
actions.description: Insert a blank row at the caret row by shifting rows down (keeps canvas size).

actions.title: Insert Column (Shift Right)
actions.description: Insert a blank column at the caret column by shifting columns right (keeps canvas size).

actions.title: Select Row
actions.description: Select the full row at the caret.

actions.title: Select Column
actions.description: Select the full column at the caret.

actions.title: Select Row to Start
actions.description: Select from start of row to caret.

actions.title: Select Row to End
actions.description: Select from caret to end of row.

actions.title: Select Column to Top
actions.description: Select from top of column to caret.

actions.title: Select Column to Bottom
actions.description: Select from caret to bottom of column.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 1 (F1)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F1 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 2 (F2)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F2 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 3 (F3)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F3 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 4 (F4)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F4 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 5 (F5)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F5 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 6 (F6)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F6 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 7 (F7)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F7 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 8 (F8)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F8 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 9 (F9)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F9 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 10 (F10)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F10 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 11 (F11)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F11 in the active character set.

actions.title: Insert Character Set Slot 12 (F12)
actions.description: Insert the glyph mapped to F12 in the active character set.

actions.title: Export PNG…
actions.description: Export the active canvas as a PNG image.

actions.title: Paste As Selection
actions.description: Paste clipboard into a floating selection layer (not wired).

actions.title: Swap Foreground/Background
actions.description: Swap the active foreground and background colours (not wired).

actions.title: Move Block (Selection)
actions.description: Move the active selection block (cut to floating selection).

actions.title: Copy Block (Selection)
actions.description: Duplicate/copy the active selection block (not clipboard copy).

actions.title: Fill Block (Selection)
actions.description: Fill the selection rectangle (not flood-fill) with the current brush/attribute (configurable in Select tool).

actions.title: Erase Block (Selection)
actions.description: Erase the selection contents (alternate to Delete).

actions.title: Stamp Block (Selection)
actions.description: Stamp/place the floating selection contents (keeps floating selection active for copy-mode).

actions.title: Center Selection
actions.description: Center the selection on the canvas (tool-gated; not wired).

actions.title: Toggle Transparent Paste
actions.description: Toggle transparent-paste mode for selection placement (tool-gated; not wired).

actions.title: Crop to Selection
actions.description: Crop canvas to the active selection bounds (not wired).

actions.title: Top of Document
actions.description: Move caret to the top of the document (not wired).

actions.title: Bottom of Document
actions.description: Move caret to the bottom of the document (not wired).

actions.title: Delete Forward (Shift)
actions.description: Delete character under caret (shift cells left).

actions.title: Tab
actions.description: Move forward by tab stop / insert tab (not wired).

actions.title: Reverse Tab
actions.description: Move backward by tab stop (not wired).

actions.title: Actual Size
actions.description: Reset view scale to actual size.

actions.title: Open Colour Palette
actions.description: Open the command palette in colour mode.

actions.title: Set Reference Image…
actions.description: Load/set a reference image overlay (support pending; not wired).

actions.title: Toggle Reference Image
actions.description: Toggle reference image overlay visibility (not wired).

actions.title: Connect to Server…
actions.description: Connect to a collaboration/chat server (support pending; not wired).

actions.title: Toggle Chat Window
actions.description: Show/hide chat window (support pending; not wired).

actions.title: Tool Mode: Keyboard
actions.description: Switch to keyboard mode (mode-gated; not wired).

actions.title: Tool Mode: Brush
actions.description: Switch to brush mode (mode-gated; not wired).

actions.title: Tool Mode: Shifter
actions.description: Switch to shifter mode (mode-gated; not wired).

actions.title: Tool Mode: Paintbucket
actions.description: Switch to paintbucket mode (mode-gated; not wired).

actions.description: Apply tool preset slot 1 (the 1st preset for the active tool).
